Frequently Asked Questions

What is Freelanzo?

Freelanzo is India's gig event staffing and gig work platform. It connects event organisers and businesses with local event staff and gig workers for exhibitions, promotions, corporate events, weddings, retail stores and other occasions.

How can I hire event staff in Bangalore?

Send a WhatsApp enquiry on Freelanzo or call 9620055756 with your event date, location and the number of staff you need. Freelanzo will match you with trained local event staff.

What types of event staff can I hire?

You can hire event promoters, hostesses, ushers, registration desk staff, sampling and promotion staff, wedding helpers, exhibition staff, retail store staff and general event crew.

How do I find one day event jobs?

Choose Freelancer / Gig Worker in the WhatsApp enquiry form and send your details. Freelanzo shares one day event jobs, weekend jobs and day jobs that match your availability and location.

Can students do gig work with Freelanzo?

Yes. College students and freelancers can take up flexible one day and weekend event jobs with Freelanzo around their studies.

How do I contact Freelanzo?

Call 9620055756, send a WhatsApp enquiry from the website, or follow Freelanzo_ on Instagram at instagram.com/freelanzo_.
